A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the arsenium cation 9a is a labile species, which can easily be oxidized to the cyclo-di-arsadiazane 11.
the stibenium cation in 13 has a significant stibenium nature, but the arsenium species 9a is more covalent.
the arsenium and antimony species studied here can be regarded as the Lewis acids, whereas the GaCl3 and AgOTf species can be seen as the Lewis bases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the stibenium cation is more labile than the arsenium cation.
the arsenium cations are much more stable than the antimonium cations and that the stibenium character is much more pronounced than the arsenium character.
in the case of the arsenium compounds 5 and 9, the cations show a strong tendency to form dative bonds with the anionic counterion.
